name: Battle Fortune
body:
School transmutation (fate); Level bard 5, cleric 5, paladin 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area creatures within a 30-ft.-radius spread
Duration 1 minute
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

You alter the fate of up to six creatures of your choice within range. For the duration, the melee and ranged attacks of the chosen creatures inflict an additional 1d6 damage.
